purpose: Explain an unavoidable or personal reason, often apologetically.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause / Nな / な-adjectiveな + ものだから
The trains stopped, so I ended up arriving late.
It is my first time, so I do not know how things work.
It was so quiet that I thought no one was there.
formation: Plain clause / Nな / な-adjectiveな + ものだから
restrictions: Often explains a past action and can sound like an excuse.
mistake: Use な, not だ, after nouns in the standard form.
